docker_bin_path.description: Path to the Docker binary that this profile applies to.

docker_config_paths.description: Paths and patterns allowing access to Docker configuration files (e.g., daemon.json, certificates, seccomp profiles).

items.description: File or directory pattern with wildcards (e.g., '/etc/docker/**')

docker_state_paths.description: Paths and patterns allowing read/write access to Docker state and container images.

items.description: File or directory pattern with wildcards (e.g., '/var/lib/docker/**')

docker_socket_path.description: Path to the Docker daemon socket that containers may access (usually for `docker-in-docker` scenarios).

seccomp_profiles.description: Paths to seccomp filter profiles used by Docker containers.

items.description: Path to a seccomp JSON profile file; supports glob patterns (e.g., '/etc/docker/*.json').

allow_dangerous_caps.description: List of Linux capabilities the Docker daemon requires. Remove any capability if you need to tighten security (e.g., for highly restricted environments).

deny_rules.description: List of explicit 'deny' rules for fine-grained security hardening (e.g., '/proc/*/mem w').

items.description: A denial rule line (e.g., 'deny /proc/*/mem w,'). Must end with comma.

mount_rules_enabled.description: Enable 'mount' and 'umount' permissions. Disable only if you're not using overlay/other storage drivers that require them.

ptrace_enabled.description: Enable 'ptrace' capability for debugging and introspection (e.g., `docker top`, `docker inspect`). Disable in maximum-security environments.
